caption: The drawing features a single object composed of two main parts: a cylindrical handle and a curved blade. The handle is horizontally oriented, colored in shades of light to medium brown, and appears solid and smooth with slightly rounded edges. Attached to the center of the handle is a short, straight metal rod that connects to the center of a wide, crescent-shaped blade. The blade is grayish-metallic, displaying subtle variations in shading that suggest a worn surface, and it is positioned with its convex edge curving downward. The background is an off-white or lightly yellowed plain surface with no additional objects or decorative elements. The composition centers the object, and a small signature appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Food Chopper
